column2: What's this, giving up already?
Well, that's fine too. Knowing when to quit is part of being human.
Oh? You two...
Giving up, with just the two of you and your friends left behind?
Oh! Who are you?
...Wow.
Pfft... ahahaha! You're so weird!
Ahahahahahahaha!
Hehe... What are you doing in a place like this?
Lots of things? Like what?
?? I don't really get it...
Hmm, so you're still a kid.
Huh? What's that supposed to mean?!
Is that so? ||| Hmm, something feels off about that, though...
Do you like dandelions?
Hmm...
Oh, I know!
Ta-da! Marie's special sandwich! ||| It has no dandelions or sunflowers, but it does have canola flowers from our garden. ||| I bet it tastes like sunshine! ||| Now, open wide...
Is that so...? ||| Oh, I get it! You don't like the cold!
Hehe, wait here a moment. I'll go gather some firewood. ||| Once I get a fire going, it'll warm right up. ||| ...See?
Y-yes, ma'am!
Rules: Estelle and Noche face off one-on-one in a fishing match. The game is played over ten turn-based rounds, with you and your opponent acting alternately.
I can't take this anymore... ||| They got away from us, and Lord Campanella keeps picking on us... ||| And on top of that, it ends up like this, with a result that makes no sense...
What have we been made to do all this time?!

Hehe, good work, everyone. ||| But working even at a time like this? Aren't you being a bit too diligent? ||| Oh, it's something out there. ||| A sight you couldn't see for a million Mira. ||| There's still time, so why not go watch it too?
Absolutely not, sir!
Hehe... I suppose that's a tall order for people who've been conditioned like you. ||| Anyway, mind letting me through? ||| I have a little business with the Sanctum.
B-but... even for you, Lord Campanella, without the Professor's permission...
Oh, the Professor? He's dead.
What...?!
What, do you think I'm lying? ||| Hmm. That hurts my feelings a bit. ||| All right, I'll give you the same fun experience Gilbert had. ||| Then I think you'll start believing what I say.
N-no, it's just...
Then hurry up and go watch what's outside. ||| The one who ordered you to stand guard is gone now, after all.
We'll do just that, sir!
Hehe, so they're no longer useful. ||| Well, it'd be a waste to wipe their memories and cast them out. Maybe I'll take the whole unit on myself.
Heh, even the noise outside doesn't reach in here. ||| Well, it wouldn't do its job otherwise.
-- Access. ||| Enforcer No. 0, Campanella the Jester. ||| On behalf of the Third Apostle of the Serpent, Georg Weissmann, I request entry to the Chamber of Stars.
So the Phantasmal Blaze Plan is finally underway... ||| The groundwork is thorough. Its scale and perfection must surpass the Gospel Plan by far. ||| Hehe... this is going to be interesting.
...By the way. ||| I'm hardly one to talk, but--
--Whoever you are, that's enough peeping, don't you think?
...... ||| ...Hey, Bleublanc. ||| Don't just stay silent. Say something...
Heh, the same goes for you... ||| In the face of this sight, any words are powerless. ||| We can only be awed and overwhelmed.
...So the others never came back after all... ||| Not much of an ending, is it?
...Renne seems to have already left this airspace. ||| Lucciola is missing, but there is little we can do worrying about her.
Heh... I'm not worried, really. ||| It's just that she's too good a woman to let die. ||| I only hope she doesn't die in vain.
Heh, I agree. ||| But as for Loewe, there is probably no hope.
...Yeah. ||| Tch, I should've just fought him and gotten it over with. ||| That bastard always found some excuse to avoid a bout with me...
Unlike us, he had a clear purpose. ||| And it seems that purpose has been fulfilled. ||| He must be at peace by now.
Heh...
...After the festival, huh...
...I had a lot of fun today.
Nothing seems to happen.
Hmph... As I thought. ||| This time's target is most likely a toy that they scattered about.
Are you all right?! Hold on!
Yeah... I pushed myself way too hard... ||| But I'm fine. It won't be like before. ||| I've decided to face myself, and Big Sis Rufina, properly.
...Kevin...
Ries?!
O-oh, yes! I was just gathering a few seashells.
Yes, I'm fine. It seems he's not here today.
Is Lucia running an errand?
Oh, right. The bazaar starts today, doesn't it?
Pauly's been looking forward to it!
Rules: Estelle and Fisher face off one-on-one in a fishing match. The game is played over fifteen turn-based rounds, with you and your opponent acting alternately.
......? ||| (...I don't understand any of this...)
Dragonfly!
I told you, I don't need that...
Marga Monitor Lizard!!
Ugh... ngh... ||| ...Aaaaaah!!
Sis, I... ||| ...I can't take any more...
...Honestly, night after night... ||| You're such a busybody...
Okay!
Check it out, pretty great, huh? I caught this myself!
...Shiny!
I'm off!
Yes, those two did come to this shop.
They were chatting like old friends at a table.
I couldn't hear what they were saying, of course...
Lila was smiling, which is rare, so I remember it well.
R-really, smiling, huh... ||| So, Plata. Do you remember what the man looked like?
Hmm, neat and tidy, I'd say. A nice-looking guy.
I don't know much about his character, though.
I see, I see.
...So, Anelace, why are you asking all this?
Um, well, that's because...
No, I get it. It's love, isn't it?
Come to think of it, the look on Lila's face then...
That was definitely the face of a girl in love.
Hmm, so spring has finally come for Lila too.
W-we don't know that yet, okay? ||| Plata... please don't tell any other customers, all right?
Okay, I get it, I get it!
Rules: Estelle and Lloyd face off one-on-one in a fishing match. The game is played over five turn-based rounds, with you and your opponent acting alternately.
...I've been expecting you.
It's been a while, Colonel. ||| I'm glad to see you well.
...No, today I'll deliberately call you "Colonel."
...Colonel, there is something I wish to ask you. ||| It is presumptuous of me, but that is why I called you here.
...Colonel, then let me ask...
Why did you leave the military?
Where has your patriotism gone?!
...Colonel, I am by no means blaming you.
...You thought about this country more than anyone. Your patriotism was truly genuine.
I swore to follow you, and I was indeed happy.
True, I may find it hard to be promoted now, but...
...That doesn't matter.
I returned to the army and serve this country once more. That makes me happy.
...I never had any intention of holding a grudge against you.
Colonel, what happened to you?
...You, who worried so much about this country's future...
You didn't stand up for this country again, and left the army so quickly...
And now you've started a company and do business with the wealthy...!
Where... where has your patriotism gone?!
...Colonel, please return to the army.
You should return to military service and put your abilities to use!
You have already atoned more than enough.
General Morgan and Brigadier General Cassius are both waiting for your return.
All of us are looking forward to it!
...Yet why do you wear such a face...
...Why do you apologize to me...!
C-Colonel...?
...N-no... ...That can't be... ||| ...Then your patriotism hasn't vanished... ||| It's because you kept it that you couldn't remain in the army...?
That can't be... ...You were far more...
...So your company is what makes that possible...
...You won't return to the army, then...
You're... unfair...
Your reasoning is probably right. You are always right, and there is no room to argue.
But...
You are no longer the man who said he would carve out Liberl's tomorrow...!
We probably won't meet again! Excuse me...!
...Director...
...Let's go back. You'll catch a cold.

...I'm sure he's just confused. ||| He can't forget the fervor of the Intelligence Division, so he seeks a place for his heart somewhere. ||| ...But someday, he will understand. ||| I was the same, after all...
...Yes.
I couldn't possibly. ||| Seeing off one's superior is a subordinate's duty.
...Leave it to me. ||| I will handle any request with the utmost care. ||| I know very well that you enjoy taking on small requests, Director.
J-Julia's falcon...?!
Pyui!
How dare it perch on His Excellency's arm... ||| Glare...!
P-Pyui...?!
Pyupyui!
Pyui pyui!
From Army Headquarters...? ||| Why would a Royal Guard messenger carry such a thing...
Pyui!
U-um, Director...? ||| That letter, could it be...
...Thanks for the hard work on the business trip. ||| The Royal Army is concerned about the Crimson Stellas' movements too, so please look into that while you're at it...
Don't worry so much, Teacher.
The children draw their strength from your smile, you know?
...I think he's a very good boy.
Yeah, got it!
So you hand them out after school? ||| Hmm, I'd turn it down, myself.
Um... uh, Kloe... ||| If you like, we could help you too? ||| We happen to have some errands around town anyway...
No, this is my job. ||| Jill, Hans, excuse me.
*sigh*...

W-well, the belt got caught... ||| It's stuck...
A-Agate?! ||| Why are you here...?
Is it... my mother?! ||| She told me to come, so...
Okay, Dad. ...You promise! ||| Don't build it without me knowing!
Y-yeah...
Good night...
...zzz, zzz...
